title: Williams builds $1.6B Socrates on-site gas power for Meta's Ohio campus

sources.quote: Commercialized Socrates, a $1.6 billion Power Innovation project to serve growing AI demand in Ohio, backed by a long-term, fixed-price power purchase agreement
In project filings, the data center electricity consumer is listed as Sidecat, LLC, an affiliate of Meta.

explain: Williams is building and running the Socrates gas power plants that feed Meta's data center campus in New Albany, Ohio, and is paid under a long-term fixed-price power purchase agreement. The $1.6 billion figure is Williams' project cost, not the contract value, which was not disclosed. Plants: Socrates South and Socrates North power generation facilities (New Albany, Ohio), about 556 MW combined per Williams' 2026 10-Q.
